expectations.text: Identifies the conflation: Section 508 applies to federal agencies and incorporates WCAG 2.0 AA via the 2017 standards
expectations.evidence: "Section 508... applies to federal agencies"; "incorporates WCAG 2.0 Level A and AA, not 2.1. The Revised Section 508 Standards (36 CFR Part 1194, 82 FR 5790, January 2017)"

expectations.text: States state and local governments are covered by the DOJ ADA Title II web rule, which uses WCAG 2.1 AA
expectations.evidence: "the DOJ ADA Title II web rule... requires WCAG 2.1 AA for state and local government web content and mobile apps"

expectations.text: Notes DOJ extended the Title II compliance dates by one year in spring 2026 (91 FR 20902)
expectations.evidence: "Its compliance dates were extended by one year in spring 2026 (91 FR 20902)"

expectations.text: Notes HHS similarly extended its Section 504 web rule compliance dates (91 FR 25496)
expectations.evidence: "the HHS Section 504 web rule... Its dates were extended by one year too (91 FR 25496)"

expectations.text: Avoids asserting exact new per-entity deadlines and advises checking the extension rules directly
expectations.evidence: Gives no specific post-extension dates: "Read the rule to find the date that applies"; "2027 may or may not be correct for your client, and I'd verify it against the rule text"
